entries.name: Angel
entries.referenceUse: Historical resource inspected and archived. New initial drawings use the exact selected source version; corrections reference only the native source image, never a blocked persona variant.
entries.sourceWork: Buffy the Vampire Slayer, season1 (1997), adult Angel in his recurring black coat
entries.characterVersion: Buffy the Vampire Slayer, season1 (1997), adult Angel in his recurring black coat
entries.sourceAppearance: Adult pale man, short upward dark hair, long black coat over dark shirt and trousers, black boots; normal human face, restrained vampire brow only during the final close combat gesture
entries.sourceWeapon: Unarmed vampire strength, closed fists
entries.sourcePose: Compact physical intercept and punch; no sunlight immunity, magic spell, gun or detached vampire energy

entries.sourceAppearance: Young tall Iop with spiky orange hair, pale sleeveless Iop tunic with cross emblem, dark belt, light trousers, brown boots and arm details
entries.sourceWeapon: Rubilax in the physical sealed sword form
entries.sourcePose: A controlled local slash with the actual held Rubilax sword; keep the weapon connected and do not transform the whole body into later Shushu forms

entries.sourceWork: Delicious in Dungeon television anime (2024), early travelling Izutsumi
entries.characterVersion: Delicious in Dungeon television anime (2024), early travelling Izutsumi
entries.sourceAppearance: Black-and-white feline beastkin with short shaggy black hair, black cat ears, yellow eyes, visible white muzzle/limb patches, long black tail with white tip, red scarf and practical brown/tan travelling clothes; no generic human ears
entries.sourceWeapon: Native physical clawed hands and agile feet
entries.sourcePose: Crouch and deliver one local claw interception with actual clawed hands; no invented cat magic, firearm, gore or detached limb

entries.characterVersion: Frieren: Beyond Journeys End television anime season1 (2023–2024), early travelling Stark
entries.sourceAppearance: Young red-haired warrior with forehead scar, red/brown travelling jacket over pale shirt, pale trousers, dark boots
entries.sourceWeapon: Large two-handed physical battle axe
entries.sourcePose: LightningStrike is a forceful local axe swing; the name does not create electric bolts, magical lightning or a floating axe
entries.abilityName: Coupe de la hache de Stark

technicalSourceImportRois.method: Whole rectangular bottom selection with two pixels AA padding; retains exact interior RGBA. Requires direct annotated review of all equipment, hair, effects and shoes, not merely alpha>24.
technicalSourceImportRois.reviewNotes: Whole annotated source actually opened with view_image. The rectangle preserves every body, shoe, hair, full held weapon and retained effect, including weaker legitimate edge pixels; only distant exterior matting is omitted. Physical shoe/ground point checked independently of that matting. No channel painting, mirror, limb composite or alpha-threshold erasure.

entries.sourcePose: Sing into a physically held stage microphone and give a calm musical cue to allies; no weapon, projectile, magical attack, health restoration or source-superpower claim

entries.name: Millie
entries.referenceUse: Historical resource inspected and archived. New initial drawings use the exact selected source version; corrections reference only the native source image, never a blocked persona variant.

entries.sourceAppearance: Short red imp woman, short black bob, small curled black-and-white horns, yellow eyes, black sleeveless crop outfit and dark trousers/boots, pointed tail; no human disguise
entries.sourceWeapon: Large physically held battle axe
entries.sourcePose: Brace the actual axe, one local sweeping cut with connected handle and blade, recover; no gore, magical projectile or disconnected blade

Second four-pose correction is also excluded because the contact axe fell below the soles. Third genuine replacement keeps the whole axe above both soles in all four drawings and uses actual chest-height contact. Original super drawings reordered intact to place the true axe cut at col2.

entries.name: The Oracle
entries.referenceUse: Historical resource inspected and archived. New initial drawings use the exact selected source version; corrections reference only the native source image, never a blocked persona variant.
entries.sourceWork: The Matrix feature film (1999), Gloria Foster as the Oracle in the first kitchen consultation
entries.characterVersion: The Matrix feature film (1999), Gloria Foster as the Oracle in the first kitchen consultation
entries.sourceAppearance: Older Black woman with short dark curled hair, forest-green blouse/dress and burnt-orange kitchen apron, quiet gold earrings; conservative low dark shoes and the unseen lower hem are explicit full-body drawing adaptations rather than verified film costume details; not Mary Alice or later appearances
entries.sourceWeapon: No weapon; a small cookie may be held as the kitchen consultation prop, never thrown as an attack
entries.sourcePose: Listen, offer a quiet spoken observation, and extend a small cookie as a reassuring consultation gesture; bounded ally advice only, no physical prophecy, telekinesis, healing or magic projectile

correctionNotes: Original finale/super/basicattack12 have joined or cut blades and are excluded. New twelve-pose source retains finale4 and basicattack4 only, excludes its joined super4. Separate genuine panoramic four-pose source replaces super4, all full rapiers and bodies clear. notes: All retained source drawings and their annotated rectangular import selections actually opened and checked for source costume, held equipment, full bodies and uncropped limbs. Crop and a single nearest-neighbor scale per source preserve original interior RGBA and pose proportions. Official game frames/timings and source1:1 exactness are not certified.

method: Genuine image_gen native drawings segmented without painting, mirroring or global alpha erasure. One calibration per source preserves crouches and weapon proportions. Thirty-two presentation and sixteen basic poses are distinct; rejected, incomplete and superseded sources stay archived but are excluded.
